title: GE4u Daily Practice: Public Health English
topic: Y tế công cộng · Public Health English
objective: Review three core terms and practise one knowledge check in Public Health English.

vocabulary.definition: Ongoing collection and interpretation of health data.
Occurrence of new cases in a population over time.
Proportion of a population with a condition at a given time.
vocabulary.example: Prevalence was estimated from survey data.

quiz.question: Which term is defined as: Ongoing collection and interpretation of health data.
quiz.explanation: surveillance means Ongoing collection and interpretation of health data.
